goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: T028 closes every T026 finding within the approved boundary. Restore defaults now uses live preference application, cancelling and reconfiguring activation. A behaviorally tested one-shot controller tracks both Control gesture origin and moving terminal position, while every later pointerdown invalidates stale suppression. Region capture is limited to stage padding or the real artboard. Zero-extent objects receive scale-aware nonzero halos, region start publishes hover-free context, and persistent guidance follows the activation preference. Fresh targeted verification passes 194 tests; full typecheck, all 384 tests, and production build pass. T027 browser QA may begin.

evidence.proof: Restore defaults now passes the reset value through applySelectionPreferences, which detects activation changes, cancels the active gesture, configures the live controller, removes ready state, and updates editor/UI state. Controller coverage proves configuring M to Left Control disarms M and requires a fresh ControlLeft keydown.

ContextMenuSuppressionController records the accepted origin and continuously updates the terminal point for the matching pointer. It consumes one matching Control contextmenu near either coordinate. Behavioral coverage moves from (10,20) to (110,90) and proves terminal suppression.

A document-capture pointerdown invalidates any prior token before stage capture can optionally accept the new gesture. Tests prove invalidation and exclusion of non-canvas, non-Control, expired, and already-consumed events. ControlRight, handles, and ordinary right-click therefore cannot inherit a prior accepted token.

Region eligibility now requires the target to be contained by the real artboard and not be a resize or rotation handle; main separately admits the stage element for padding starts. Behavioral coverage accepts artwork and rejects a non-artboard button, preserving disconnected-banner controls and other stage UI.

Halo geometry applies a scale-aware two-screen-pixel minimum independently to width and height and centers the expansion around the authored bounds. Horizontal and vertical line regressions prove both halo dimensions remain positive while clean SVG and undo history remain unchanged.

beginMarquee clears hover and immediately publishes selection context. Behavioral coverage first establishes a hovered object, begins the region gesture, and proves the latest context has no hovered node, allowing Layers to remove stale salmon prediction before commit.

The persistent inspector hint now has a dedicated target updated alongside shortcut-dialog copy. Left Control describes start-anywhere drag plus exact Control-click; M describes start-anywhere region drag without claiming exact-toggle behavior.

T028 does not alter threshold latching, candidate/Shift freezing, ControlLeft identity, ControlRight exclusion, M no-op semantics, exact toggle, pan precedence, ordinary object drag, actual handles, or editor cancellation restoration. Existing substantive gesture tests remain green.

evidence.finding: Retained feedback, accessibility, and transform boundary
evidence.proof: Per-object halos remain filter-independent, noninteractive, aria-hidden, serialization-free, and history-free. The statusbar count remains outside collapsed sidebars; Layers expands and marks every selection. Only the primary receives blue handles, with no union box or collective transform introduced.

evidence.proof: Four files and 194 tests passed in the Judge's fresh run.
Typecheck passed, all 20 test files and 384 tests passed, and the production build completed successfully.

items: At 100% zoom, hold physical ControlLeft and press ordinary artwork. Release below 4px to exact-toggle it; repeat after crossing 4px and returning near the origin to prove the sequence remains a marquee and never moves the object.

ControlLeft-drag from artwork, white artboard, SVG-root pixels, and stage padding. Repeat with Shift frozen at pointerdown and verify replace/add behavior selects every expected visible leaf-most object without ancestors.

At non-default zoom with both sidebars collapsed, repeat start-over-artwork and empty-canvas marquee; verify transformed geometry, violet markers, primary blue handles, and the persistent N objects selected badge.

On macOS, ControlLeft-click and ControlLeft-drag far from the origin; neither may open a context menu. Immediately test ordinary right-click, ControlRight-click, and ControlLeft interaction with resize and rotation handles; native/handle behavior must remain available.
If the disconnected-preview banner can be shown, ControlLeft-click its banner and retry control; no region gesture may start and the control must remain operable.

Choose M activation and verify start-anywhere drag, Shift-add, and sub-threshold no-op. While M is armed or a gesture is active, use Restore defaults and confirm clean cancellation, Left Control copy/state, M no longer arming, and a fresh ControlLeft press being required.
Hover artwork until canvas and Layers show salmon prediction, then begin a Control and an M region; both salmon indicators must disappear immediately before commit.

Select filtered artwork plus horizontal and vertical lines with enhanced outlines on and off at both zoom levels; every object must retain an individual crisp violet halo, while only the primary shows blue handles.

With a Layers search and collapsed ancestors, create a multi-selection spanning branches; verify the filter clears when necessary, every ancestry expands, all selected rows are marked, the primary is stronger, and only the primary scrolls into view.

Cancel via ControlLeft/M keyup, Escape, blur, hidden-tab transition, pointercancel, and lost capture; confirm restored selection, no stuck cursor/overlay/capture, and a fresh activation key requirement.

Recheck ordinary object drag, Alt/double-click, configured precise modifier, Space-drag, middle-drag, wheel zoom, resize, rotation, locked and hidden layers, contain/touch modes, dialog keyboard/focus behavior, and reduced motion.

After all selection-only probes, confirm Save and Undo remain disabled, exported SVG is byte-clean of halos/handles/settings, Layers and badge match canvas selection, and the browser console is empty.
